candidates.excerpt: Punjab's Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann has leveled allegations against the BJP, claiming the use of Central investigative agencies for political leverage. He interpreted the recent CBI raids on his office as a signal of an impending election campaign. Mann reiterated his dedication to the interests of Punjab's citizens, dismissing corruption claims and drawing parallels with similar tactics in other states with non-BJP leadership.

candidates.title: India aims to be self-reliant in shipping and shipbuilding by 2047: Sonowal
candidates.excerpt: Union minister Sarbananda Sonowal said the government is building an ecosystem to help domestic shipyards win global orders as India targets a spot among the world's top five shipbuilding nations.

candidates.title: In Rahul Gandhi's Delhi March, A Punjab Sub-Plot Plays Out
candidates.excerpt: Days after being replaced as Punjab Congress president, Amarinder Singh Raja Warring was on the frontlines of the Congress-led Opposition's protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, at one point climbing atop the police bus carrying Rahul Gandhi.

candidates.excerpt: Bajrang Dal firmly refuted claims of organizing a gathering at Jantar Mantar on October 10 for their demonstration. The group expressed discontent over being linked to potential violence against protesters. CJP co-convener Ashutosh Ranka voiced concerns over right-wing groups being mobilized for violent purposes. candidates.title: 20-year-old dies after alleged assault in Talabkatta
candidates.excerpt: A 20-year-old Talabkatta youth, Shaik Ismail alias Ashu, died while undergoing treatment after allegedly being assaulted by his friend. Ismail suffered severe head injuries and remained unconscious before his death at Osmania General Hospital on Thursday.

candidates.title: AP local body polls: SEC awaits Supreme Court verdict to announce schedule
candidates.excerpt: The SEC directed district officials to remain prepared and ensure that all logistical, security, and administrative arrangements are in place to facilitate smooth conduct of the elections.

candidates.title: 'Dhappa' gets Day 3 twist as cops allow Rahul, INDIA bloc MPs to protest at Raj Ghat
candidates.excerpt: Opposition leaders, after previously being stopped by police, successfully reached Raj Ghat for their protest. They staged a brief sit-in to honor Mahatma Gandhi while voicing their concerns about electoral integrity. Congress leaders accused the government and Election Commission of undermining democratic rights and engaging in a conspiracy. Rahul Gandhi emphasized the need for justice regarding these electoral issues.
